c.v: Short frame synchronization under PCM standard requires WS signal changes one BCK clock cycle earlier than SD signal on the falling edge of BCK, which means that the WS signal becomes valid one clock cycle before transferring the first bit of channel data and remains unchanged in this BCK clock cycle.
SD signal line transmits the most significant bit of audio data first.
Compared with PCM standard, TDM PCM standard supports multiple channels, see Figure 28.5-3.
